<<On Repointing A Chimney Stack This Season>>

Chimney repointing is a crucial maintenance task that ensures the safety and efficiency of your home’s heating system. Over time, mortar between the bricks can deteriorate, crack, or become loose, which can lead to chimney fires or inefficient heat transfer. A professional repointing involves removing old mortar, cleaning the bricks, and replacing them with new, high-quality mortar. This process not only improves the chimney’s structural integrity but also enhances its performance and longevity.

Local residents are encouraged to schedule a chimney repointing with a certified contractor during the season when the chimney is less busy. It’s a simple yet important task that can save you from potential hazards and costly repairs in the future. The work is typically done in the fall or early spring, when the weather is cooler and the chimney is less likely to be exposed to extreme conditions.

P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
